notes: Read SKILL.md and references/examples.md in full. Java guide for com.azure:azure-security-keyvault-secrets: SecretClient creation with DefaultAzureCredential, set/get/update/list secrets, delete/recover/purge, backup/restore, async patterns, a config-loader and a rotation pattern.

No commands for the agent to run, no package-manager invocations (only Maven <dependency> snippets), and no instruction for the agent to read, print, or send real secrets. All Key Vault calls are sample code for the user's application against the user's own vault; secret values in samples are obvious placeholders ("P@ssw0rd123!", "sk_live_abc123xyz", "<secret-value>").

Several samples print secret values to stdout (SKILL.md:88, references/examples.md:69-70, 106-107, 146-148, 178-180, 300); users adapting them should not log real secret values. purgeDeletedSecret (SKILL.md:181, references/examples.md:259) is irreversible, and SKILL.md:196 writes a secret backup blob to a local file. references/examples.md pins a beta package version (4.11.0-beta.1) while SKILL.md uses 4.9.0.
